title: One-Month Outcomes of Intravitreal Anti-VEGF vs. Dexamethasone Implant in the Treatment of Diabetic Macular Edema in Vitrectomized Eyes

license.statement: CC BY (article <license>: 'Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY)'; no version or URL given in the licence element)

condition: Clinically significant diabetic macular edema in eyes previously vitrectomized (PPV with panretinal photocoagulation at least 1 month before baseline, mostly for vitreous haemorrhage or vitreomacular traction); prospective, open-label/subject-masked randomised 1:1 single-centre trial (Second Xiangya Hospital), 70 eyes of 70 patients, 1-month duration

groups.description: IVV group: one ranibizumab injection at baseline (monthly retreatment allowed if criteria met; data collected only to month 1)
IVD group: one dexamethasone implant at baseline (retreatment every 3 months allowed if criteria met)

exclusions.reason: duplicates the Table 3 baseline cells (same eyes); Table 3 cited
the same groups have absolute series in Table 3, which are used

exclusions.what: Table 2 and Table 4 BCVA, Table 5 IOP elevation counts
exclusions.reason: not thickness; counts are not admissible

exclusions.what: Results-text CRT changes by DME pattern (IRC vs IRC+SRD) and proportions with >=20% CRT change
exclusions.reason: text-only changes without tabulated baselines; proportions are not admissible

notes: Time origin: the intravitreal injection or implant at the baseline visit (Day 1); visits at Week 1 and Month 1 (Day 2 visit had no OCT)
CRT measured on RTVue XR Avanti (Optovue) SD-OCT/OCTA, not defined as the central 1-mm subfield, so measure central_unspecified
Both arms are standard treatments compared without an investigational agent: both control (randomisation 1:1; right/left eyes split between arms for bilateral eligibility, but 70 eyes of 70 patients)
Prior intravitreal anti-VEGF or steroid treatment of the DME was allowed outside washout windows (4, 8 and 16 weeks) but not reported: prior_treatment unstated; all eyes had prior PPV with PRP
Other treatments for macular edema were prohibited during the study except for safety; none reported

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 3 row Baseline, column 'IVV Group Mean ±SD')
series.notes: Mean ± SD; Table 3 column n. gives the same number of eyes at baseline, week 1 and month 1; week 1 = 0.2300 months after the baseline injection (Day 1); one injection in the reported period

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 3 row Baseline, column 'IVD Group Mean ±SD')
series.notes: Mean ± SD; same visits and per-visit n as the ranibizumab series; one implant in the reported period; one eye received IOP-lowering medication at month 1 (no thickness values removed)
